svg.title: How LLM Security Gateway works
svg.desc: LLM apps trust whatever users type, and whatever the model answers; this open-source proxy sits in between. Requests from your app pass through the gateway before reaching the LLM API: 01 rate limit (429 on abuse), 02 prompt-injection check (403 BLOCKED), 03 PII masking (e-mail becomes [EMAIL]). Responses are scanned for leaked PII on the way back.
svg.text: LLM apps trust whatever users type, and whatever the model answers. This proxy sits in between.
open source · one `docker compose up` · early stage, feedback welcome
response is scanned for leaked PII on the way back
